findings.evidence: Bodies are `pointsMap (zpowersHom …)`; the `pointsMulEquiv_*` lemmas fully determine each map on points (a `Multiplicative ℤ →* Aˣ` is fixed by its value on `ofAdd 1` via `MonoidHom.apply_mint`), so no consumer must unfold.
findings.fix: Drop `@[expose]` from `charPoints` (:95), `cocharPoints` (:113), and `powEnd` (:131); the in-file proofs already see the body (same module) and require no exposure.
findings.issue: `charPoints`, `cocharPoints`, `powEnd` are `@[expose]` even though their point-level characteristic lemmas (`pointsMulEquiv_charPoints` at :102, `pointsMulEquiv_cocharPoints` at :120, `pointsMulEquiv_powEnd` at :137, plus `powEnd_one`/`powEnd_comp`/`charPoints_comp_cocharPoints`) already let consumers avoid unfolding. Exposing the bodies only grants downstream defeq access to `pointsMap (...)`, coupling consumers to the implementation.

findings.evidence: `pairing m ψ := (ψ m).toAdd` at :162; `pairing_ofAdd` covers only the rank-1 case, no general restatement exists.
findings.fix: Drop `@[expose]` and add `theorem pairing_def (m ψ) : pairing m ψ = (ψ m).toAdd := (rfl)` (parenthesized `rfl` so downstream does not rely on defeq).
findings.issue: `pairing` is `@[expose]` with no `*_def` characteristic lemma, so its only reduction rule downstream is defeq to `(ψ m).toAdd`.

findings.evidence: Docstring lines 33-36, 160-167 call it the perfect pairing; no bilinearity lemma appears in the file.
findings.fix: Add characteristic lemmas `pairing (m*m') ψ = pairing m ψ + pairing m' ψ`, `pairing 1 ψ = 0`, and `pairing m (ψ*ψ') = pairing m ψ + pairing m ψ'` (all follow from `MonoidHom` multiplicativity and `toAdd_mul`).
findings.issue: `pairing` is documented as the perfect pairing / root-datum input but has no lemma stating its defining ℤ-bilinearity (additive in `m` and in `ψ`); with `@[expose]` dropped this leaves it structurally uncharacterized.

summary: The point-level characteristic lemmas already characterize charPoints/cocharPoints/powEnd, so their `@[expose]` bodies are unnecessary; pairing is exposed with no `_def` restatement and no bilinearity lemma establishing its defining property as a pairing.
